cases.sentence: И то в эти три дня меньшой заболел оттого, что его накормили ___, а остальные были вчера почти без обеда.
cases.explain: «дурным бульоном» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Darya Alexandrovna, in a dressing jacket, and with her now scanty, once luxuriant and beautiful hair fastened up with hairpins on the nape of her neck, with a sunken, thin face and large, startled eyes, which looked prominent from the thinness of her face, was standing among a litter of all sorts of things scattered all over the room, before an open bureau, from which she was taking something. Hearing her husband’s steps, she stopped, looking towards the door, and trying assiduously to give her features a severe and contemptuous expression. She felt she was afraid of him, and afraid of the coming interview. She was just attempting to do what she had attempted to do ten times already in these last three days—to sort out the children’s things and her own, so as to take them to her mother’s—and again she could not bring herself to do this; but now again, as each time before, she kept saying to herself, “that things cannot go on like this, that she must take some step” to punish him, put him to shame, avenge on him some little part at least of the suffering he had caused her. She still continued to tell herself that she should leave him, but she was conscious that this was impossible; it was impossible because she could not get out of the habit of regarding him as her husband and loving him. Besides this, she realized that if even here in her own house she could hardly manage to look after her five children properly, they would be still worse off where she was going with them all. As it was, even in the course of these three days, the youngest was unwell from being given unwholesome soup, and the others had almost gone without their dinner the day before. She was conscious that it was impossible to go away; but, cheating herself, she went on all the same sorting out her things and pretending she was going.

cases.sentence: – Минуты… минуты увлеченья… – выговорил он и хотел продолжать, но при этом слове, будто от физической боли, опять поджались ее губы и опять запрыгал мускул щеки на ___ лица.
cases.explain: «правой стороне» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “—instant of passion?” he said, and would have gone on, but at that word, as at a pang of physical pain, her lips stiffened again, and again the muscles of her right cheek worked.

cases.sentence: – Я помню про детей и поэтому все в мире сделала бы, чтобы спасти их; но я сама не знаю, чем я спасу их: – тем ли, что увезу от отца, или тем, что оставлю с ___, – да, с развратным отцом…
cases.explain: «развратным отцом» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “I think of the children, and for that reason I would do anything in the world to save them, but I don’t myself know how to save them. By taking them away from their father, or by leaving them with a vicious father—yes, a vicious father. … Tell me, after what … has happened, can we live together? Is that possible? Tell me, eh, is it possible?” she repeated, raising her voice, “after my husband, the father of my children, enters into a love affair with his own children’s governess?”

cases.sentence: Что делать? – говорил он ___, сам не зная, что он говорит, и все ниже и ниже опуская голову.
cases.explain: «жалким голосом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “But what could I do? what could I do?” he kept saying in a pitiful voice, not knowing what he was saying, as his head sank lower and lower.

cases.sentence: В это время в ___, вероятно упавши, закричал ребенок; Дарья Александровна прислушалась, и лицо ее вдруг смягчилось.
cases.explain: «другой комнате» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: At that moment in the next room a child began to cry; probably it had fallen down. Darya Alexandrovna listened, and her face suddenly softened.

cases.sentence: Это было ___ ее от домашних забот, которые обступали ее, как только она выходила.
cases.explain: «единственное убежище» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Darya Alexandrovna meanwhile having pacified the child, and knowing from the sound of the carriage that he had gone off, went back again to her bedroom. It was her solitary refuge from the household cares which crowded upon her directly she went out from it. Even now, in the short time she had been in the nursery, the English governess and Matrona Philimonovna had succeeded in putting several questions to her, which did not admit of delay, and which only she could answer: “What were the children to put on for their walk? Should they have any milk? Should not a new cook be sent for?”
